snippet.title: Frog Legs Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Available NOW!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1734110/Frog_Legs/
What if Resident Evil and Frogger had a boomer shooter baby? Then you'd get Frog Legs, a new horror-action game by The Man in the Park creator, Elliott Dahle.
